title: Making a hair appointment
instructions: Bir kadın kuaförden randevu alıyor. Gün, saat ve hizmete dikkat et.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hi. I'd like to book a haircut and colour, please.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Sure. When would you like to come?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Thursday is fully booked. We have Friday at two or Saturday at eleven.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I work on Fridays. Saturday at eleven, please.

script.speaker: a
script.text: OK. A cut and colour takes about two hours. It's seventy pounds.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Fine. My name is Kate Wilson.

questions.evidence: I'd like to book a haircut and colour, please.

questions.prompt: Why can't she go on Thursday?

questions.feedback: Cuma çalıştığı için cumartesi on bir.

questions.evidence: A cut and colour takes about two hours.
